EuclideanSpace real (Fin m) is the real m-dimensional inner product space with the l2 norm. Fin m indexes coordinates from zero. WithLp.toLp 2 and WithLp.ofLp preserve entries; inner real is the ordinary real Euclidean inner product.

Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) real is the full group of real orthogonal matrices, containing either determinant sign. A matrix coerced from this group has inverse equal to its transpose. Matrix multiplication by a vector and the dot product are finite sums.

Matrix.reindex e e M has entries M (e.symm i) (e.symm j). Matrix.blockDiagonal B is indexed by pairs (local coordinate, block index) and vanishes between distinct blocks. Matrix.fromBlocks assembles its four displayed blocks. The symbol 1 denotes the identity matrix.

Equiv.prodComm exchanges the factors. finProdFinEquiv sends (a,b) to a times the cardinality of the second factor plus b. finSumFinEquiv concatenates the summands; finCongr transports along its displayed equality of cardinalities. Sum.elim selects the indicated branch.

HasGradientAt f v x means that f has a genuine Frechet derivative at x represented by the inner product with v. The operation gradient f x is totalized: it selects the derivative-representing vector when differentiability holds and otherwise returns zero. The displayed conjunction includes HasGradientAt as a conclusion; this context does not supply it as a premise.

Bool has the two values false and true; the displayed conditional chooses its first branch when true and its second branch when false. Scalar multiplication and real arithmetic have their usual meanings; natural division and remainder are floor division and remainder. A product equality asserts equality of both components.
